The '''Captain of the Guard''' was a title given to a commander of troops. In the [[Onderonian military]], the title was given to three concurrent individuals. In [[3951 BBY]], it was held by [[Bostuco]], [[Riiken]], and [[Gelesi]], who inherited the title upon [[Sullio]]'s death.

The [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] also used this rank and its holder answered directly to (and was likely appointed and dismissed by) a [[Senate Guard committee/Legends|Senate committee]].

[[Jesra Loture]] served as Captain of the Guard during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

The same title was used by the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] officer in charge of the guard at [[Kharys]]'s fortress. The [[Rryatt Ceremonial Guard]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] was also led by a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] of this rank.<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>
